requirements.statement: Only the exact delivery closure and empty writable root are visible.
World, case, gold, oracle, scoring, renderer, nonvisible-vector, evaluation, and adjudication artifacts are absent and access-denied.

receipt_visibility.primary_implementer_prohibited_scope: No review, acceptance, source-seal, access-probe, fixture-authority, parity, or final-seal receipt may be produced or self-certified by PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTER.
receipt_visibility.author_visible_control_projection: Only the exact two-field opaque projection schema is visible; semantic receipt identity, producer, authority, timing, evidence, state, and failure detail remain absent.
receipt_visibility.implementation_reviewer_access: IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWER receives the exact sealed implementation deliverables and implementer receipts it reviews through an event-bounded control-side allowlist after output freeze.

shared_schema_contract.limitation: No full source schema annotation, alternate schema, or semantic mapping is recipient-visible.

external_digest_prerequisite.rule: Every source snapshot and external prerequisite has exact raw-byte SHA-256 in the delivery manifest before dispatch.

delivery_contract.detached_manifest_rule: manifest_sha256 is uppercase SHA-256 of RFC8785 JCS after replacing manifest_sha256 and delivery_seal_sha256 with 64 uppercase zeros; the manifest is not an entries member.
closure_validator: The schema enforces exactly 48 non-manifest entries: one packet, one baseline projection, 36 exact source IDs, one visible conformance projection, two exact toolchain binaries, and seven exact opaque projections.
Every path resolves to one regular read-only file; raw byte length and SHA-256 must match; links, escapes, duplicates, omissions, extras, zero digests, and unlisted media types fail.
commands is exactly the four ordered const objects; command_set_sha256 and toolchain_manifest_sha256 must recompute exactly.
Absent or unresolved S30 or S31 makes dispatch false.

implementer_visible_contract.rule: Exactly one local-synthetic conformance vector and expected output per fixture class; every entry is independently authored and sealed by FIXTURE_TEST_AUTHOR before recipient access.

negative_access_contract.rule: No nonvisible vector, expected output, selection rule, seed, case, world, gold, oracle, renderer, or semantic acceptance detail is recipient-accessible.

external_fixture_test_pack_prerequisite.implementer_limitation: PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTER may author only the deterministic runner and adapter against the read-only visible vectors; it MUST_NOT author, select, modify, or infer fixture inputs, expected semantics, or acceptance authority.
external_fixture_test_pack_prerequisite.dispatch_rule: The visible projection and opaque two-field pack-seal projection must both validate and be exact-digest sealed; absence or FAIL blocks dispatch and never authorizes invention.
external_fixture_test_pack_prerequisite.projection_sha256_rule: Set projection_sha256 to 64 uppercase zero characters; RFC8785-JCS serialize; uppercase SHA-256 the JCS bytes; store the digest. LF is excluded.

invariants: Both handles share implementation, runner, source, toolchain, budget, pause, clarification, and visible-field digests.
The sole difference is the sealed closed change card.
Both disabled slots remain disabled and output-identical.

parse_rules: Reject input exceeding 16777216 bytes before decode.
Select the lowest error precedence applicable: empty, UTF-8, BOM, duplicate key, JSON/trailing bytes, NFC, safe-number, schema, resource limit, internal.
Strict decoding rejects BOM, invalid UTF-8, duplicate object keys, trailing bytes, non-NFC strings, NaN, Infinity, negative zero, floats, and integers outside [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991].
Within one precedence select the RFC6901 pointer with smallest UTF-8 bytes; emit one error only.

determinism.canonicalization: RFC8785 JCS; keys sort by Unicode scalar value and arrays retain order
determinism.numeric_model: integers only in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; negative zero and floats forbidden
determinism.clock: DENIED; logical time must be explicit input
determinism.randomness_seed_nonce: DENIED; no seed or nonce accepted
determinism.network_subprocess_environment: network denied; subprocess denied except the fixed launch; ambient environment ignored
determinism.repeatability: Identical request bytes and sealed delivery bytes yield byte-identical stdout, stderr, and exit code.

deterministic_runtime_contract.atomicity: Construct, validate, and hash fully in memory; write no output file; make exactly one stdout write only after finalization; any pre-write failure uses the deterministic error envelope; no retry or partial write.
deterministic_runtime_contract.receipt_sha256_rule: Set receipt_sha256 to ZERO64; RFC8785-JCS serialize the complete response; uppercase SHA-256 those JCS bytes; store digest; RFC8785-JCS serialize; append LF. LF is excluded from the digest.

deterministic_runtime_contract.request_id_rule: Use the request_id only after strict JSON parsing and exact RUN_ pattern validation; otherwise use RUN_000000000000000000000000.
deterministic_runtime_contract.exact_error_bytes_rule: For the selected error construct the exact response object fixed by response_schema with receipt_sha256=ZERO64; set receipt_sha256=SHA256_UPPER(JCS(zeroed_object)); stdout is JCS(final_object)+LF. No alternate message, field, order, whitespace, or additional error is permitted.

reference_contract.resolution: The digest must resolve to exactly one delivered or emitted regular file; the pointer must select exactly one value of the schema-required type.
reference_contract.failure: zero, absent, multiple, malformed, cyclic, byte-mismatched, type-mismatched, unlisted, or out-of-root resolution is UNRESOLVED and fails closed.

canonical_seal_preimages.implementation_tree_sha256: SHA256_UPPER(JCS({domain:"PCB-IMPLEMENTATION-TREE-0.2",entries:SORT(files,BY_UTF8_RELATIVE_PATH)})); each record must match a real regular file and the closed output tree exactly.
canonical_seal_preimages.implementation_manifest_sha256: Set sha256=ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(JCS(complete_manifest)); the implementation_tree_sha256 is already populated and nonzero.
canonical_seal_preimages.toolchain_tree_sha256: SHA256_UPPER(JCS({domain:"PCB-TOOLCHAIN-TREE-0.2",tools:SORT(tools,BY_UTF8_ENTRY_PATH)})); each raw_sha256 resolves to the exact delivered regular file.
canonical_seal_preimages.toolchain_manifest_sha256: Set manifest_sha256=ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(JCS(complete_toolchain_manifest)); tree_sha256 is already populated and nonzero.
canonical_seal_preimages.implementer_receipt_sha256: Set receipt_sha256=ZERO64; SHA256_UPPER(JCS(complete_receipt)); subject_sha256, evidence_sha256, and state_sha256 must be nonzero and resolve to the receipt-kind subjects defined by the schema.

seal_resolution_invariants: A tree record exists iff its regular file exists under the exact root; path, media type, byte length, and raw digest match; symlinks, aliases, missing files, extra files, and duplicate paths fail.
No all-zero digest, placeholder, unresolved reference, or record without real subject/evidence/state bytes can enter a seal preimage.
Changing any subject, evidence, state, file, path, byte length, command, or tool version changes the corresponding canonical preimage and requires recomputation.
